Robosys is a leading provider of Artificial Intelligence (AI) powered Maritime Autonomy and Smart Shipping software with two decades of experience in the field.
Our VOYAGER AI software can transform a new or existing vessel into a fully autonomous Uncrewed Surface Vessel (USV), capable of independent navigation, autonomous collision avoidance, obstacle and anti-grounding with dynamic route optimisation.
We use our own cutting edge AI and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to provide scalable levels of autonomy, from Remote Control up to and including full IMO degree 4 Autonomy.
In its simplest form, VOYAGER AI can also provide Collision Avoidance Decision Aid (CADA) support which is COLREGs compliant, for a vessel’s master to enhance the safety, productivity and efficiency of a lean crewed ships.
At the next stage as an AI based “Intelligent” Marine Pilot it can autonomously control a lean crewed ship. Or, in a fully fledged USV, VOYAGER AI enables remote control & piloting, fully autonomous navigation and control including obstacle, collision and grounding avoidance utilising the latest AI enabled vessel identification and perception systems.

Founded in 2003, the University of Dubrovnik (UNIDU) is one of the youngest public universities in Croatia, situated in the southernmost region of the country on the Adriatic coast. Despite its relatively recent establishment, UNIDU has rapidly developed into a dynamic and interdisciplinary institution offering degree programmes and conducting research in fields such as digital economy, tourism, ecology, electrical engineering, computer science, maritime sciences, art and cultural heritage restoration. In recent years, the University has increasingly focused on emerging technologies, particularly in exploring the application of artificial intelligence, intelligent systems and information technologies to optimise and manage complex processes across various sectors. Through these efforts, UNIDU has positioned itself as an important regional knowledge hub capable of addressing the challenges faced by communities balancing the preservation of cultural, historical and natural resources with the demands of sustainable development and industry. 
As the most internationalised Croatian university in terms of Erasmus+ student share, UNIDU plays a unique role in fostering inclusive growth within the European Higher Education Area. It provides high quality education to a diverse and mobile student body, helping to shape future professionals who are able to contribute to their communities and beyond.
UNIDU’s integrated structure allows for strong interdisciplinary collaboration in both teaching and research. Its scholars from fields such as engineering, ecology, economics, biotechnology, maritime sciences, computer science and cultural heritage work together on innovative projects aimed at solving pressing global challenges. The University’s mission is to produce and transfer knowledge that is both academically sound and socially relevant, benefiting not only the local and regional environment but also a wider European and international context.

Volvero is an app for sharing vehicles that connects owners with people who need one, saving time and money. We improve quality and security through AI and advanced technologies with crystal-clear full insurance coverage. Volvero is easier, safer and more reliable than any other app in the field.

Volvero is a drive sharing app where owners can share their vehicles with drivers. Our app creates a system in which one can have access to a car, a motorcycle, or commercial vehicle in the most efficient and sustainable way saving time and money. By registering on our platform owners can set the sharing time, distance, price, and other terms, being able to accept or decline drivers’ request. At the same time, drivers are able to choose any vehicle and terms of sharing that best suit their needs. With the help of AI and advanced technologies, Volvero guarantees maximum security and transparency providing necessary information such as the performance of owners, drivers, and vehicles. Overcoming outdated paperwork, Volvero creates smart contracts at the start of the ride while one of a kind built-in insurance covers drivers and all kinds of vehicles. 

Modern society is in need of new efficient transportation alternatives. Indeed, public transport is crowded, inflexible or absent, especially in extra-urban areas. At the same time, car rental services are rigid and expensive, thus people not owning a private vehicle are restricted from free movement. Still, car ownership is not feasible taking into account that the society is facing a high underutilization of vehicles with cars not being used 96% of the time occupying parking spaces and producing pollution. This includes corporations that own vehicles that could be monetized and car dealers that are looking for new business models as millennials are not interested in car purchasing. The problem, therefore, has three dimensions which are people in need of economic transportation for different needs, owners in need of reducing their vehicles’ costs, and the issue of overproduction and under usage of vehicles contributing to pollution and waste of resources.

By providing a marketplace Volvero connects owners and drivers effectively bringing to use underutilized vehicles and providing an extensive range of efficient mobility possibilities to the drivers. Having this access to transportation enhances people’s well-being by giving them freedom of moving, more possibilities, and eliminating social inequality. At the same time owners, both private and commercial can significantly reduce their vehicles’ costs and make the ownership feasible. Car rentals and dealers have a chance to switch from the outworn business model to a profitable modern one. With Volvero fewer vehicles wander in the cities as each one is utilized more, raising the actual average use of them and favouring a fast turnover of old cars with newer less polluting ones. These factors entail a pollution reduction, and traffic jams, reducing the need for urban spaces for parking areas, thus converting them into more useful and productive facilities.

National Institute of Chemistry (NIC) is the scientifically excellent, established and breakthrough research institution based in Slovenia, Europe. With our cutting-edge research, we are enriching the global treasury of knowledge by solving the most pressing challenges facing society including health, sustainable energy, climate change, circular economy and safe food. Basic and applied research are focused towards fields that are of long-term importance to both Slovenia and the world: biotechnology, environmental protection, empirical and theoretical chemistry, analytical chemistry, materials research, and chemical engineering, through which the Institute performs a world class basic research and supports the needs for technology transfer of the domestic chemical, pharmaceutical, and food industries.
Our research goals push the boundaries of science and create new values. We successfully transfer knowledge to industry and, in the long-term, support the role of science in the development of society. We enable scientific excellence through collaboration with the best global research institutions, groups and individuals. We are members of international multidisciplinary research networks, such as CERIC-ERIC, SUSCHEM, EMIRI, EERA Bioenergy, Fuel Cells and Hydrogen Joint Undertaking, Vision 2020, Slovenian Strategic Research and Innovation Partnership (SRIP), Centre of Excellence for Low-Carbon Technologies, Slovenian Business and Research Association. We aim to be provide the stimulating environment and open learning space where our 100 young researchers can develop their curiosity and realise their research creativity in PhD work. By doing so, we ensure future generations lives benefit from the profession. NIC has 350 employees, of which around 280 carry out research work in 8 departments & 2 infrastructure centres. We provide our employees with inspiring working conditions in which they can carry out their professional mission. We are proud that our interpersonal relationships are based on an open, integrated, equitable and inclusive culture that is not limited by gender or race. We strive to become the reason for excellent Slovenian scientists returning from abroad. With our mission, we contribute to the well-being of society and are an example of excellence.
NIC’s employees publish more than 200 scientific papers per year and are strongly involved in international basic and applied projects. Research is oriented towards the development of new technologies and products, which will help to ensure the long-term development of Slovenia, and which are internationally relevant. National Institute of Chemistry one of the leading Slovenian organisations for graduate-level education and training.
Industry is an important partner of the Institute in these endeavours. There is a number of Slovenian companies with whom the Institute has entered into a close long-term cooperation, as well as with a number of innovative international companies from pharma to nanomaterials. This kind of cooperation accounts for the 20% of the income of the Institute. NIC is also a constituting member of several excellence and competence centres, such as the Centres of Excellence ENFIST, Polymers and Low-Carbon Technologies.

SENER Sp. z o.o. is a subsidiary of SENER SIS, well recognised Spanish company operating in space sector since 1967.
In Space, SENER has developed from its beginnings mechanisms and mechanical systems that cover almost all the needs of the Flight Segment. Moreover, SENER supplies essential items for completing successful missions, such as Attitude or Control Systems (AOCS) and Guidance, Navigation and Control systems (GNC). All this is backed up with technical solvency, successfully proven with more than 20 satellites and spacecrafts currently operating with SENER equipment on board. In fact, SENER has a major history of meting deliveries, with which it has achieved a reputation for quality and reliability in Space. 
In its 40 years, SENER has supplied over 150 systems for 46 satellites without a single failure. The company has taken part in ESA and NASA missions such as the Hubble Space Telescope, Columbus, Envisat, Rosetta, Meteosat, Herschel and Planck, Metop, Mars Science Laboratory or GAIA, as well as commercial missions such as Hispasat, Spainsat or XTAR-EUR.
SENER Sp. z o.o. is operating as Polish company with activities performed fully in house but benefitting from support and technology transfer from SENER SIS on the basis of exploring the synergies and complementarities.
Activities of the company are focused on space segment and space system engineering in the following areas:
¿ Mechanical and Actuation Systems (elements, equipments and systems)
¿ Navigation & Space System Engineering (Systems Engineering, GNC/AOCS)
¿ Optical Systems (Complete sensors, Instruments).

Autroni AS is a growth company founded in 2015, specializing in professional robotic lawnmowers for international airports. The company has developed innovative solutions that enable robotic lawnmowers to operate efficiently at airports without requiring closures during mowing operations.
While the initial focus is on grass cutting, Autroni’s technology has the potential to address other operational needs in airports, industrial areas, and public spaces where safety is paramount.
Autroni’s reliable mowing robots maintain airport safety areas in compliance with the strictest safety standards. Extensive testing at Stavanger Airport, Norway, demonstrated that robotic mowing is a cost-effective, sustainable, and round-the-clock solution tailored for airports. Additionally, it significantly reduces the presence of birds and mammals, enhancing aviation safety.
The company leverages the expertise of Yamabiko Europe, a leader in robotic mowing for large grass surfaces. Yamabiko Europe is part of Yamabiko, a globally recognized outdoor equipment manufacturer listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, renowned for its innovative products in agriculture, forestry, and landscaping.
Since 2017, Autroni has successfully deployed solar-powered mowing robots at Stavanger Airport. A fleet of 18 robots trims every square meter of safety areas at low height every 72 hours, drastically limiting the presence of birds and mammals in the turf and reducing bird strike risks. This automated approach simplifies operations and lowers costs by eliminating the need for off-hours personnel, extensive training, safety clearances, and heavy machinery.
Following the success at Stavanger, plans are underway to expand robotic mowing to other airports in the Avinor group.
Today, Autroni serves customers across Europe, Asia, America, and Australia, positioning itself as a global leader in robotic solutions for safety-critical environments.

entityDescription:
Compute Maritime is an innovation company providing AI-powered tools and solutions to help the maritime industry achieve its net-zero goals.

Our first tool in this effort is NeuralShipper™, the world’s first GenAI tool for ship design and optimisation. It is built on physics-informed diffusion and transformer models and trained on over 100,000 physically validated 3D ship hull designs across various ship types.NeuralShipper™ comprises three key modules: (I) design, (II) optimisation, and (III) simulation.

Our innovation lies in NeuralShipper’s design module, which integrates interactive and generative design capabilities into the preliminary design stage, enabling the creation of both customer-centred and high-performance designs. The generative design capability allows both experienced and novice ship designers to rapidly explore efficient design concepts. The interactive feature is particularly tailored for the yacht industry, where designs must be not only high-performing but also visually appealing.

In addition to design creation and optimisation, NeuralShipper™ enables users to develop machine learning-based surrogate models to bypass computationally expensive physical solvers for performance prediction. While surrogate modelling is not new, it has traditionally required strong machine-learning expertise. With NeuralShipper™, this process becomes straightforward, requiring only basic data and programming skills, making it easy for designers to get started.

We currently have four users on board. Among these, a key partner is Siemens, a leading provider of engineering design and simulation tools. The other users include two yacht design offices and MARIN, Europe’s largest research institution supporting the shipbuilding and offshore industries. Additionally, we are in discussions with well-known ship design firms, including Feadship, Delta Marine, and Damen.

Materialise will celebrate its 35th anniversary this year (2025). Materialise incorporated over three decades of 3D printing experience into a range of software solutions, 3D printing services and applications. Materialise combines the largest group of software developers in the AM industry with the largest 3D printing facilities in the world. Open flexible solutions for Additive Manufacturing enable players in a wide variety of industries to make steps in applying AM for their business context, including healthcare, automotive, aerospace, art and design, and consumer goods. Materialise is known as an innovative company which strongly enables other players to build innovative 3D printing applications in their own domain.
Materialise has been built around three core competences: 3D-printing known-how, engineering of applications and software development. The unique value of our company is that these competences are present in one entity, and we can leverage on strong synergies between the different competence teams. For instance, software development can ‘crystallize’ the 3D printing know-how and benefit from early testing and validation of software in the Manufacturing division. The Manufacturing division benefits from state-of-the-art software solutions which are continuously improved in-house. Also engineering an AM application can be done in a fast way with custom and specialized software tools.
These core competences are brought to the market in different ways through our three business segments: Manufacturing, Medical and Software.

entityDescription: Transforming Textiles AB is a Swedish deep-tech company developing Re:Weave, a dual-use circular system platform integrating smart textiles, embedded sensing, and regenerative material cycles for space and Earth applications. The company is registered and headquartered in Sweden, with full ownership, decision-making authority, and intellectual property retained within the Swedish entity. At the core of the platform is Sense-Tex, a patented smart textile and yarn technology combining embedded sensing, antimicrobial protection, durability, and recyclability by design, enabling textiles to function as both human–system interfaces and recoverable material resources. Re:Weave extends this foundation into a system-level architecture supporting autonomous operation, reduced resupply dependency, and Zero Debris principles, aligned with ESA priorities for long-duration missions and future habitats. Earth-based applications in healthcare, professional use, and circular manufacturing are used as validation pathways while maintaining space-grade design constraints.
